name: Christians Being Single
overview: Scripture acknowledges the value of companionship, as God declared it was not good for man to be alone and provided a suitable helper for him (Genesis 2:18). Marriage is affirmed as a good gift from the Lord, bringing favor to those who find a spouse (Proverbs 18:22). Yet, Jesus teaches that in the resurrection, earthly marital status will no longer apply, and believers will be like the angels in heaven, indicating that singleness has a distinct and honored place in the Christian life (Mark 12:25).
